description: Golden dataset for the domain-expert eval harness. Each case gives the CORRECT domain (routing quality is measured separately by routing_golden.json — this harness isolates expert quality given correct routing), an issue, a synthetic repo (file tree with plausible distractors + manifest excerpts), the labeled relevant files a good expert should identify, and a reference root_cause used by the judge to score the technical summary. Matching rules live in scoring.py (ancestor-directory and glob predictions count; fabricated paths are counted as hallucinations).

cases.title: Save button on settings page doesn't respond to clicks
cases.body: On /settings, clicking Save does nothing — no spinner, no request in the network tab. Started after the last release. Repro in Chrome and Safari.
cases.root_cause: The save button's click/submit handler is not wired up or is broken on the settings page — the form never dispatches a save request.

cases.title: Email field accepts invalid addresses
cases.body: The signup form submits 'a@b' as a valid email. Should validate format client-side before submit and show an inline error.
cases.root_cause: The signup form's email validation is missing or too weak — no format check runs before submit, so malformed addresses pass through.

cases.title: Add CSV export endpoint for transactions
cases.body: Need GET /api/transactions/export returning CSV of all transactions for the authed user. Should stream for large datasets and require the same auth as /api/transactions.
cases.root_cause: A new authenticated streaming CSV export endpoint must be added to the transactions router, reusing the existing auth dependency.

cases.title: Login endpoint has no rate limiting
cases.body: POST /auth/login can be hammered indefinitely. Add per-IP rate limiting (e.g. 5 req/min) returning 429 with Retry-After.
cases.root_cause: The login route has no rate-limiting middleware; one must be added (or a shared limiter module created and mounted) so repeated attempts get 429 with Retry-After.

cases.title: Deploys failing with OOM on the worker service
cases.body: Since last week the worker container gets OOMKilled during rollout. Bump memory limits and add a liveness probe so the rollout doesn't wedge halfway.
cases.root_cause: The worker deployment's container memory limits/requests are too low and it lacks a liveness probe, so the rollout OOMKills mid-deploy.

cases.title: CI pipeline intermittently fails on cache restore
cases.body: The build job fails ~30% of the time restoring the pnpm cache with a tar corruption error. Pin the cache key to the lockfile hash and add a fallback restore key.
cases.root_cause: The CI workflow's pnpm cache key is unstable (not pinned to the lockfile hash) and has no fallback restore-keys, so cache restores intermittently corrupt.

cases.title: App crashes when rotating to landscape on profile screen
cases.body: On Android, rotating the device on the profile screen loses form state then crashes with a NPE. Repro: open profile, type in bio, rotate.

manifests.pubspec.yaml:
name: app
dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter

cases.root_cause: The profile screen doesn't survive configuration change — form state isn't retained across rotation and a null reference is dereferenced after rebuild.

cases.title: Messages sent offline never sync when back online
cases.body: In airplane mode the app lets you 'send' messages, but they vanish instead of queuing and syncing when connectivity returns.
cases.root_cause: Offline sends aren't persisted to an outbox/queue that a connectivity-driven sync drains — messages composed offline are dropped instead of queued.

cases.title: Model accuracy dropped 8 points after feature pipeline refactor
cases.body: Validation accuracy fell from 0.91 to 0.83 right after the feature-pipeline refactor merged. Suspect train/serve skew — the serving path wasn't updated.
cases.root_cause: The refactor changed training-time feature logic without updating the serving path (or vice versa) — train/serve skew is degrading accuracy.

cases.title: Nightly ETL duplicates rows when re-run after failure
cases.body: If the nightly load job fails midway and re-runs, the warehouse ends up with duplicate rows for the same partition. Re-runs should be idempotent.
cases.root_cause: The load step appends blindly instead of upserting/deleting by partition, so a re-run after partial failure duplicates rows.

cases.title: CLI exits 0 even when the build fails
cases.body: `artisan build` prints an error and 'BUILD FAILED' but still exits 0, so our CI step passes when it shouldn't. Failure should exit non-zero.
cases.root_cause: The build command's failure path doesn't propagate a non-zero exit code through main() — the error is printed but the process exits 0.

cases.title: Config file overrides CLI flags — precedence is backwards
cases.body: `tool run --region eu` still uses the region from ~/.toolrc. Flags should beat env vars, which should beat the config file.
cases.root_cause: Configuration resolution merges sources in the wrong order — config-file values overwrite flag values instead of the reverse.

cases.title: OTA update bricks device if power drops mid-flash
cases.body: Two field units died during OTA when power dipped mid-flash — bootloader jumps into a half-written image. Update needs atomic swap or rollback.
cases.root_cause: The OTA path writes over the running image in place with no dual-slot/atomic swap or validity flag, so an interrupted flash leaves an unbootable image.

cases.title: I2C read hangs the whole main loop when sensor unplugged
cases.body: If the temp sensor is disconnected, the blocking I2C read never returns and the watchdog resets the board every ~2s. Needs a timeout.
cases.root_cause: The blocking I2C read has no timeout/error path for a missing device, so it spins forever and trips the watchdog.

cases.title: Frame rate tanks when explosion particles spawn
cases.body: FPS drops from 60 to ~20 whenever an explosion goes off. Profiler shows massive GC pressure from the particle system every frame.
cases.root_cause: The particle system allocates new particle objects per frame instead of pooling/reusing them, causing GC spikes and frame drops.

cases.title: Jump input feels laggy — sometimes eats the press
cases.body: Players report jump sometimes registers a beat late or not at all, especially at low FPS. Input is sampled inside the render loop instead of a fixed-timestep update.
cases.root_cause: Jump input is polled in the variable-rate render path rather than queued and consumed by the fixed-timestep update, so presses are missed or delayed at low FPS.

cases.title: Stored XSS via profile bio field
cases.body: Saving <script>alert(1)</script> in the bio field executes for anyone viewing the profile. Needs output encoding/sanitization.
cases.root_cause: The bio is stored and rendered without sanitization/output encoding (likely dangerouslySetInnerHTML or raw HTML injection), allowing stored XSS.

cases.title: Webhook URL field allows SSRF to internal services
cases.body: Setting a webhook URL to http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data fetches it — the server makes the request from inside our VPC. Validate/allowlist outbound URLs.
cases.root_cause: User-supplied webhook URLs are fetched server-side with no scheme/host validation or egress allowlist, enabling SSRF against internal/metadata endpoints.

cases.title: Orders list endpoint takes 30s+ to load
cases.body: GET /orders?status=pending does a full table scan — 2M rows. The query filters on status and created_at but there's no index covering them.
cases.root_cause: The orders query filters/sorts on unindexed columns (status, created_at); a composite index via a new migration is needed.

cases.title: Migration locked the users table for 6 minutes in prod
cases.body: The last deploy's ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN took a full table lock and rewrote the table. Need an online approach for large tables.
cases.root_cause: The migration performs a blocking ALTER TABLE on a large populated table instead of an online pattern (e.g. nullable column + backfill, or pg-safe concurrent approach).
